throughline.zh: 本週電子需求仍由 AI、伺服器與記憶體拉動，但台灣及東南亞的最新資料顯示，產能落地同時受材料認證、原料、人力、工安、電力與網路韌性約束。
throughline.en: AI, server and memory demand continue to support electronics activity this week, while the latest Taiwan and Southeast Asian evidence shows that capacity execution also depends on material qualification, inputs, labor, safety, power and network resilience.

title.zh: 封裝、載板與 PCB 材料從台灣延伸至馬來西亞與泰國
title.en: Packaging, substrate and PCB materials extend from Taiwan into Malaysia and Thailand

summary.zh: 本週台灣展會與公司資料涵蓋 TGV、封裝設備、載板量測、HVLP4 銅箔、CCL 與焊球。Mi Material 士乃試產、金居檳城規劃與聯茂泰國擴產均連結 AI、HBM 或高速 PCB，但量產良率、認證、原料與資本支出資料仍不完整。
summary.en: This week's Taiwan exhibition and company disclosures covered TGV, packaging tools, substrate metrology, HVLP4 copper foil, CCL and solder spheres. Mi Material's Senai trials, Goldenmax's Penang plan and Elite Material's Thailand expansion link to AI, HBM or high-speed PCBs, but yield, qualification, material and capital-spending data remain incomplete.

title.zh: 台灣與馬來西亞電子需求：訂單、出口與再出口口徑分流
title.en: Electronics demand in Taiwan and Malaysia: separating orders, exports and re-exports

summary.zh: 台灣 9 月外銷訂單 1,142.1 億美元、年增 62.4%，馬來西亞同期出口年增 54.5%，資訊通信、電子與電機電子產品為主要動力。外銷訂單、國內出口與再出口採不同定義，不能直接合計或視為單一地區實際產量。
summary.en: Taiwan's September export orders reached US$114.21 billion, up 62.4%, while Malaysia's exports rose 54.5%, driven mainly by ICT, electronics and E&E products. Export orders, domestic exports and re-exports use different definitions and cannot be added or treated as production in one location.

title.zh: 記憶體供應節點：美光台中達成協議，桃園行動影響待觀察
title.en: Memory-supply milestone: Micron settles in Taichung while Taoyuan effects remain pending

summary.zh: 美光台中工會 10 月 21 日簽署協議並撤回調解，桃園工會仍規劃 22 日進行 24 小時行動。桃園連結 DRAM 前段晶圓，台中涵蓋先進 DRAM、HBM 及封裝測試，但協議條款、參與人數與產量影響都未公開。
summary.en: Micron's Taichung union signed an agreement and withdrew from mediation on October 21, while the Taoyuan union maintained a 24-hour action planned for October 22. Taoyuan links to front-end DRAM and Taichung to advanced DRAM, HBM, packaging and testing, but agreement terms, participation and output effects remain undisclosed.

title.zh: AI 伺服器與數位基礎設施：機房、供電、交付與海纜韌性
title.en: AI servers and digital infrastructure: facilities, power, delivery and cable resilience

summary.zh: 本週資料涵蓋神雲台灣工廠投資、Bitdeer 馬來西亞機房節點、Aolani 意向書，以及台菲研議海纜保護合作。工廠規劃、預定交付、非約束性意向與政策探索分屬不同落地階段，尚不能合併為已上線算力或網路容量。
summary.en: This week's coverage includes MiTAC's Taiwan factory investment, Bitdeer Malaysian facility milestones, an Aolani letter of intent and Taiwan-Philippines exploration of cable-protection cooperation. Factory plans, scheduled deliveries, non-binding intent and policy exploration are distinct stages and cannot be aggregated as live compute or network capacity.

title.zh: 工廠擴張的執行條件：投資、電力、自動化與建廠安全
title.en: Execution conditions for factory expansion: investment, power, automation and construction safety

summary.zh: 台灣招商意向、儲能與電力公告、工廠監測示範及新加坡製造 AI 補助顯示資金與數位化投入持續增加；台積電高雄 F22 工地 4 人死亡及全台同類鋼構作業暫停，則突顯施工與復工條件也是產能時程的一部分。意向、政策資金、已驗收設備與投產產能須分開判讀。
summary.en: Taiwan investment intentions, power and storage disclosures, factory-monitoring pilots and Singapore's manufacturing-AI support show continuing capital and digitalization efforts. Four fatalities at TSMC's Kaohsiung F22 site and the suspension of similar steel work across Taiwan show that construction and restart conditions also shape capacity schedules; intentions, policy funding, accepted equipment and live capacity must remain separate.
